N = 10 Galton board: 1024 microstates bounce through 10 rows of pegs (one bounce per bit) and stack; dense crackle 214–251, peak ~232
width bracket 「宽度 ±16 %」 over the bell
last microstate lands: the counts read 1 10 45 120 210 252 210 120 45 10 1

「2⁻¹⁰⁰ = 7.9 × 10⁻³¹」 types on under it

held tension: the impossible state (456–474)
release: the molecules spread back on their own (474–496) — the arrow again
